## About these sources

Goa publishes ward-level reservation for village panchayats. The
2012 cycle names the winner; 2017 and 2022 are nomination-stage listings and
name nobody, which is a property of the document rather than a gap in the
parse. Ward numbers arrive in five different shapes, including one with a soft
hyphen inside it (`Ward­IV`), so they are normalized rather than read
literally.

## Provenance

Every row carries `source_path` and `source_page` — the document it was read from and the page within it. The documents are committed here, so any row can be checked against the page it came from without a network round trip. That mattered repeatedly: nearly every parser bug in this repository produced plausible wrong values rather than an error, and opening the page was the only way to settle it.

All 31 cited documents are present.

Inventory for this directory: 37 digital-text, 4 scan, 4 other, 3 tabular, 687 pages total.

## Acquired sources outside the parsed slices

- `2017`: 4 PDFs
- `2022`: 5 PDFs

## Reproducing

```
make goa
```

Parses from the committed documents and rewrites the files above, then runs `src/local_reservations/states/goa/validate.py`.

## What is checked

Every state runs a shared battery first — the seat key is unique, the reservation label agrees with the two fields it summarises, every `source_path` exists and every `source_page` falls inside its document. Then this state's own checks, which are the ones that catch silent corruption because they appeal to something outside the data:

- the published count of panchayats that went to poll in 2012
- the ward set, compared across the three cycles
- per-taluka coverage against 2012, which is complete


| Check | Appeals to | 2012 `gp_ward` | 2017 `gp_ward` | 2022 `gp_ward` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `alias_family_exclusive` | internal | &check; 0 | &check; 0 | &check; 0 |
| `blank_share_within_tolerance` | declared | ! unopposed 99%>0% | &check; | &check; |
| `caste_scheme_respected` | declared | &check; BC,NONE,ST | &check; BC,NONE,SC,ST | &check; BC,NONE,SC,ST |
| `caste_share_vs_population` | external | &ndash; 0 | &ndash; 0 | &ndash; 0 |
| `coverage_vs_published` | external | &check; 185 (99%) | &ndash; 684 | &ndash; 793 |
| `label_agrees` | internal | &check; 0 | &check; 0 | &check; 0 |
| `plausible_vs_registry` | external | &ndash; | &ndash; | &ndash; |
| `provenance_resolves` | internal | &check; 0 | &check; 0 | &check; 0 |
| `reservation_constant_within_seat` | internal | &ndash; | &ndash; | &ndash; |
| `rows_in_band` | declared | &check; 1471 | &check; 684 | &check; 793 |
| `seat_key_unique` | internal | &check; 0 | &check; 0 | &check; 0 |
| `tier_local_maps_to_one_tier` | internal | &check; ward | &check; ward | &check; ward |
| `winner_caste_is_not_the_seats` | internal | &ndash; 0 | &ndash; 0 | &ndash; 0 |
| `women_share_by_block` | external | &ndash; | &ndash; | &ndash; |
| `women_share_vs_statute` | external | &check; 32.2% | &ndash; 186/684 | &ndash; 307/793 |
| `year_constant` | internal | &check; 2012 | &check; 2017 | &check; 2022 |

&check; pass &nbsp; ! warn &nbsp; &cross; fail &nbsp; &ndash; skipped, meaning no rule is declared for that slice — which is not the same as passing.

Each check declares what it **appeals to**. Only an external appeal - a published total, a statutory share, a population - reliably catches silent corruption; an internal check confirms the file agrees with itself, which it does whether or not a category was misread.

Column meanings are in [../../DICTIONARY.md](../../DICTIONARY.md). Expectation violations across every state are triaged into [../expectations_report.csv](../expectations_report.csv).
